pilot.name: baltimore-canyon
pilot.notes: NOAA states that BlueTopo Atlantic Coast coverage is complete, but BlueTopo fills gaps in water deeper than 200 m with GMRT. Use BlueTopo as the seamless medium-LOD base and use survey-level NCEI multibeam for the 10 m canyon-detail contours. The NCEI Bathymetric Data Viewer query for this bbox confirms many intersecting multibeam cruises, including NOAA canyon-focused EX1404L2, EX1206, EX1302, and NF-13-09. NOS BAG catalog entries also intersect the bbox, but the offshore W00358 surface is 111 m while the 1-2 m H11554/H11555/H11873 surfaces are shelf-focused; BAGs are therefore gap-fill, not the primary canyon source. JSON has no Infinity literal, so null in coarse.zoom_range[0] means an unbounded minimum zoom. Unknown per-survey cell size or vertical datum is represented as null and must be read from file-level metadata before mosaicking.

coarse.source: GEBCO 2026 15-arc-second subset, baked into dashboard/data/gebco_bath_latest/gebco_bathy.json at runtime

source_priority: NOAA NCEI multibeam surveys intersecting bbox

mosaic_files.name: NOAA Office of Coast Survey BlueTopo
mosaic_files.format: multilayer floating-point GeoTIFF with companion Raster Attribute Table (.tiff.aux.xml); use the dated BlueTopo tile-scheme GeoPackage to resolve tile_id
mosaic_files.vertical_datum: national vertical datum; confirm the exact datum from each tile's metadata before mosaicking
mosaic_files.license: U.S. public domain; NOAA Coast Survey acknowledgement requested

mosaic_files.name: NOAA NCEI Bathymetric Data Viewer — multibeam survey selection for pilot bbox
mosaic_files.format: survey-dependent raw multibeam vendor files and processed XYZ/GeoTIFF/ASCII grids where supplied
mosaic_files.license: NOAA-distributed data; verify contributor metadata, attribution, and datum per survey

source_priority: NOAA NCEI multibeam (highest-resolution surveys for Baltimore Canyon)
NOAA NOS hydrographic BAGs where survey density is sparse

mosaic_files.name: NOAA Okeanos Explorer EX1404L2 — Our Deepwater Backyard: Exploring the Atlantic Canyons and Seamounts
mosaic_files.format: Kongsberg EM302 raw multibeam (.all.mb58.gz), processed generic XYZ soundings (.mb162), and originator-provided 25 m WGS84 grids (GeoTIFF/XYZ/ESRI ASCII)
mosaic_files.native_cell_size: 25 m for the confirmed originator-provided grid; full-resolution sounding spacing varies
mosaic_files.license: NOAA Office of Ocean Exploration and Research data; U.S. public domain with NOAA attribution requested

mosaic_files.name: NOAA Okeanos Explorer EX1206 — Northeast and Mid-Atlantic Canyons Exploration
mosaic_files.format: Kongsberg EM302 multibeam survey archive; inspect the NCEI survey record for available raw and processed deliverables
mosaic_files.license: NOAA data; U.S. public domain with NOAA attribution requested

mosaic_files.name: NOAA Ship Nancy Foster NF-13-09 — Deepwater Canyons 2013: Benthic Lander Recovery
mosaic_files.format: Kongsberg EM1002 raw multibeam vendor files (.all.mb56.gz)
mosaic_files.license: NOAA Office of Ocean Exploration and Research data; U.S. public domain with NOAA attribution requested

mosaic_files.name: NOAA National Ocean Service Hydrographic Survey BAG archive
mosaic_files.format: Bathymetric Attributed Grid (BAG), optionally converted by NCEI to ASCII XYZ with XML metadata
mosaic_files.native_cell_size: survey-dependent; bbox catalog query returned 1 m, 2 m, and 111 m BAG surfaces
mosaic_files.vertical_datum: MLLW for recent post-1980 NOS surveys; confirm per-survey metadata
mosaic_files.license: NOAA data; U.S. public domain with NOAA attribution requested
